source: class Custom{public string fileId="some-file";public string Name="authored";}

class Counter{public int Value=0;public string Text="abc";public List<int> Numbers=[1];public Counter Next=>this;public Counter Bumped{get{this.Value+=1;return this;}} public Counter? Maybe{get{this.Value+=1;return null;}} public Counter Advance(){this.Value+=1;return this;} public int Read(int x)=>x;public T Echo<T>(T x)=>x;public int Bump(){this.Value+=1;return this.Value;}}
class Probe{
public static int? OptionalMethod(){Counter? c=null;return c?.Next.Read(1);}
public static int OptionalMethodArg(){Counter? c=null;Counter x=new();var result=c?.Next.Read(x.Bump());return x.Value;}
public static int? OptionalCollection(){Counter? c=null;return c?.Numbers.First();}
public static string? OptionalBuiltin(){Counter? c=null;return c?.Text.Substring(1);}
public static int? OptionalGeneric(){Counter? c=null;return c?.Next.Echo<int>(1);}
public static int CompoundIndex(){Counter c=new();List<int>a=[10,20,30];a[c.Bump()-1]+=2;return c.Value*100+a[0];}
public static int AssignIndexOrder(){Counter c=new();List<int>a=[0,0,0];a[c.Bump()-1]=c.Bump()*10;return a[0]*100+c.Value;}
public static int IndexIncrement(){Counter c=new();List<int>a=[10,20,30];a[c.Bump()-1]++;return a[0]*100+c.Value;}
public static int CompoundReceiver(){Counter c=new();c.Bumped.Value+=10;return c.Value;}
public static int ProtoLiteral(){Dictionary<string,int>d={"__proto__":7};return d["__proto__"];}
public static int ProtoWrite(){Dictionary<string,int>d={};d["__proto__"]=7;return d["__proto__"];}
public static int ConstructorKey(){Dictionary<string,int>d={"constructor":7};return d["constructor"];}
public static string DictionaryAssetName(){Dictionary<string,string>d={"fileId":"some-file","Name":"authored"};return d["Name"];}
public static string DictionaryAssetFileId(){Dictionary<string,string>d={"fileId":"lower","FileId":"upper"};return d["FileId"];}
public static string ClassAssetName(){var d=new Custom();return d.Name;}
public static bool ReplaceArgumentError(){try{var s="abc".Replace("","x");return false;}catch(NeoArgumentError e){return true;}}
public static string ReadDictionary(Dictionary<string,string> value)=>value["Name"];
public static Dictionary<string,string> MakeDictionary()=>{"fileId":"some-file","Name":"authored"};
public static T Echo<T>(T value)=>value;
public static int? OptionalMethodPresent(){Counter? c=new();return c?.Next.Read(7);}
public static int? OptionalCollectionPresent(){Counter? c=new();return c?.Numbers.First();}
public static string? OptionalBuiltinPresent(){Counter? c=new();return c?.Text.Substring(1).ToUpper();}
public static string? OptionalExplicitBuiltin(){string? text=null;return text?.Substring(1);}
public static int? OptionalExplicitCollection(){List<int>? xs=null;return xs?.First();}
public static int OptionalBuiltinArgument(){Counter? c=null;Counter x=new();var text=c?.Text.Substring(x.Bump());return x.Value;}
public static int OptionalStatement(){Counter? c=null;Counter x=new();c?.Next.Read(x.Bump());return x.Value;}
public static int OptionalReceiverOnce(){Counter c=new();var result=c.Maybe?.Next.Read(7);return c.Value;}
public static int CompoundMethodReceiver(){Counter c=new();c.Advance().Value+=10;return c.Value;}
public static int AssignmentReceiverOrder(){Counter c=new();c.Bumped.Value=c.Bump()*10;return c.Value;}
public static int CompoundDictionaryIndex(){Counter c=new();Dictionary<string,int> d={"1":10,"2":20};d[c.Bump().ToString("D")]+=2;return d["1"]*100+c.Value;}
public static int NestedIndexAssignment(){Counter c=new();List<List<int>> xs=[[0,0],[0,0]];xs[c.Bump()-1][c.Bump()-1]=c.Bump();return xs[0][1]*10+c.Value;}
public static string DictionaryAssetParameter(){return ReadDictionary({"fileId":"some-file","Name":"authored"});}
public static string DictionaryAssetReturned(){return MakeDictionary()["Name"];}
public static string DictionaryAssetGeneric(){var value=Echo<Dictionary<string,string>>({"fileId":"some-file","Name":"authored"});return value["Name"];}
public static string ClassAssetGeneric(){var value=Echo<Custom>(new());return value.Name;}
public static string DictionaryQueryAssetName(){Dictionary<string,string>d={"fileId":"lower","Name":"authored"};var copy=d.ToDictionary((k,v)=>k,(k,v)=>v);return copy["Name"];}
public static string ListQueryAssetName(){var copy=["fileId","Name"].ToDictionary((k)=>k,(k)=>k);return copy["Name"];}
public static int OptionalMutationNull(){Counter? c=null;Counter side=new();c?.Numbers.Add(side.Bump());return side.Value;}
public static int OptionalMutationPresent(){Counter? c=new();Counter side=new();c?.Numbers.Add(side.Bump());return side.Value*10+c!.Numbers.Count();}
public static int OptionalMutationOnce(){Counter c=new();c.Maybe?.Numbers.Add(c.Bump());return c.Value;}
public static int OptionalDirectMutation(){List<int>? xs=null;Counter side=new();xs?.Insert(side.Bump(),side.Bump());return side.Value;}
public static bool? OptionalEnumeratorNull(){List<int>? xs=null;return xs?.GetEnumerator().MoveNext();}
public static bool? OptionalEnumeratorPresent(){List<int>? xs=[1];return xs?.GetEnumerator().MoveNext();}
public static int? OptionalEnumeratorCurrent(){Counter? c=null;return c?.Numbers.GetEnumerator().Current;}
public static string FilteredDictionaryName(){Dictionary<string,string> d={"fileId":"lower","Name":"authored"};return d.Where((k,v)=>true)["Name"];}
public static string FilteredDictionaryFileId(){Dictionary<string,string> d={"fileId":"lower","FileId":"upper"};return d.Where((k,v)=>true)["FileId"];}
public static int FilteredDictionaryProto(){Dictionary<string,int> d={"__proto__":7};return d.Where((k,v)=>true)["__proto__"];}
public static bool OptionalImageSlice(){NeoImage? image=null;var value=image?.Slice(0);return value==null;}
public static int OptionalImageSliceArgument(){NeoImage? image=null;Counter side=new();var value=image?.Slice(side.Bump());return side.Value;}
public static int? OptionalCloneChain(){Counter? c=null;return c?.Next.Clone().Value;}
public static int? OptionalCloneDirect(){Counter? c=null;return c?.Clone().Value;}
public static int? OptionalClonePresent(){Counter? c=new(){Value=7};return c?.Next.Clone().Value;}
public static int? OptionalMethodCloneChain(){Counter? c=null;return c?.Advance().Clone().Value;}
public static bool IsSequence<T>(T value)=>value is IEnumerable<int>;
public static bool IsListSequence<T>(T value)=>value is IEnumerable<List<int>>;
public static bool DictionaryQueryProtocol(){return IsSequence([1,2].ToDictionary((x)=>x.ToString("D")));}
public static bool DictionaryGroupProtocol(){return IsListSequence([1,2].GroupBy((x)=>x.ToString("D")));}
public static bool FilteredGroupProtocol(){return IsListSequence([1,2].GroupBy((x)=>x.ToString("D")).Where((k,v)=>true));}
public static bool FilteredListProtocol(){return IsSequence([1,2].Where((x)=>true));}
public static bool SetSeven(out int v){v=7;return false;}
public static int SwitchWritePost(){bool b=true;int x=1;return (b switch{true=>x++,false=>0})+x;}
public static int SwitchWritePre(){bool b=true;int x=1;return (b switch{true=>++x,false=>0})+x;}
public static int SwitchWriteDec(){bool b=true;int x=1;return (b switch{true=>x--,false=>0})+x;}
public static int SwitchWriteFalseGuard(){bool b=true;int x=1;var y=b switch{true when x++>5=>0,_=>x};return y*10+x;}
public static int SwitchWriteOutGuard(){bool b=true;int x=1;var y=b switch{true when SetSeven(out x)=>0,_=>x};return y*10+x;}
public static int SwitchWriteOutTuple(){bool b=true;(int,int) t=(1,2);var y=b switch{true when SetSeven(out t.Item1)=>0,_=>t.Item1};return y*10+t.Item1;}
public static int SwitchWriteThrow(){bool b=true;int x=1;try{var y=b switch{true=>x++ + "abc".Replace("","x").Length,_=>0};}catch(NeoArgumentError e){}return x;}
public static string SwitchWriteInterpolated(){bool b=true;int x=1;return $"{(b switch{true=>x++,_=>0})},x={x}";}
public static int SwitchWriteNested(){bool b=true;int x=1;var y=b switch{true=>(b switch{true=>x++,_=>0})+x++,_=>0};return y*10+x;}
public static int SwitchWriteLoop(){int x=0;for(int i=0;i<3;i++){var y=i switch{1=>0,_=>x++};}return x;}
public static int SwitchBindingsStayLocal(){object o=5;var r=o switch{int t when t>3=>t,_=>0};var s=o switch{int t=>t*2,_=>0};return r*10+s;}
public static int InitializerWrite(){int x=1;var c=new Counter{Value=x++};return c.Value*10+x;}
public static int InitializerSwitchWrite(){bool b=true;int x=1;var c=new Counter{Value=b switch{true=>x++,_=>0}};return c.Value*10+x;}
public static int ConditionalWriteControl(){bool b=true;int x=1;return (b?x++:0)+x;}
